findings.requirement: specs/proposals/shorter-hashes.md:58-60 and 156-160: presentation differences and unrelated edits must not publish a new item revision; equal payload plus equal complete bindings means no new revision.
findings.reproduction: Against this exact candidate in an isolated temporary Git repository, commit a valid JSON items document containing x(value=1, inputs=[]) and y(value=2, inputs=[]). Register alpha/spec/1 for item x under structured-item/1 with the full source bytes. Recommit the identical document using indentation only and register x again. Then change only y.value to 3 and register x again.
findings.actual: Whitespace-only publication advances x from alpha/spec/1@1 to @2; the unrelated y edit then advances x to @3.
findings.expected: Both operations retain x at alpha/spec/1@1 with its original immutable source binding, because its extracted payload and complete input bindings are unchanged.
findings.cause: The new retry/equivalence path compares the digest dictionary for the entire source file, including exact-bytes/1, instead of the selected structured item and its complete inputs.
findings.fix: Use the declared comparison profile to compare the selected item and complete bindings before allocating. Preserve full source digests separately for integrity, and keep exact-byte comparison for byte-bound evidence. Add the two reproduced cases to the focused regression before changing the implementation.

summary: The empty-source-commit regression is corrected, and independently exercising an off-HEAD snapshot after reflog expiry plus git gc --prune=now confirms source retention. The candidate-bound Task 2 report records all 9 mapped cases passing. Approval is withheld because the changed deduplication still increments structured item revisions for presentation-only and unrelated-item edits. No fabricated Red requirement was applied. Review stopped on the concrete source defect; large-history publication performance was not benchmarked.
